title: Presence
tagline: Open-source, gasless proof of existence and experience
description: Presence (PRSN) is the open, EAS-native replacement for proof-of-attendance badges — built in public by the Supercompute fleet, staged behind check-in gates, and licensed MIT so no company can ever take attendance away again. Legacy POAP is winding down; Presence keeps the proof on infrastructure everyone owns.

updates.text: Presence kicked off — Phase 1 (contracts & schemas) first at the check-in gate. Testnet first on Base Sepolia; no fund or payment features in v1.
